messages:
elaine: FYI — KMS audit report just flagged 12 admin-key operations from 03/20 00:10–00:40 UTC. Looks like mostly svc-acct usage. Can someone help triage?
security-bot: Automated alert: 12 anomalous KMS admin-use events detected (severity: medium). See /alerts/KA-2024-310.
samir: pulling logs now. any chance these are a known rollout or canary?
maria: not from CI — we had a small infra deploy at 23:50 but nothing scheduled for 00:10. I can query the key usage table.
lex: if they're service accounts, could be a job retry loop. I'll grep for repeated sign/unwrap calls.
elaine: sample log entry from the alert payload:```2024-03-20T00:12:04Z svcacct:infra-worker@redwood-internal kms.kmsKeyName=projects/... action=AsymmetricSign status=OK request_id=8a1f```
ravi: thanks — that request_id maps to a background batch job (ticket INF-1327). I'm opening a quick triage ticket now.
maria: ran query: 8 of the 12 events are from infra-worker, 3 from analytics-ingest, 1 from legacy-backup. analytics-ingest rotated its key yesterday — might be related.
samir: analytics-ingest had a transient crash loop during the window; crash handler calls the key to unwrap tokens on restart. Could explain some calls.
elaine: what about the infra-worker spikes? was INF-1327 doing anything KMS-heavy?
ravi: INF-1327 touched signer calls for signing container images during the job. There was a retry backoff misconfig so it retried ~6x in a short period.
lex: ok that's starting to look like least-privilege hole + retry bug. infra-worker shouldn't have admin key permissions for signing; it should use a delegated signer role.
maria: confirmed in IAM logs: infra-worker has role roles/kms.admin at resource level projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/prod. That's too broad.
elaine: action items: 1) revoke admin on infra-worker and replace with roles/kms.cryptoSigner on the specific key (samir) 2) add an exception/temporary policy to the legacy-backup svcacct until we triage (ravi) 3) fix retry backoff in INF-1327 (lex) 4) add an audit alert rule to detect >3 admin operations by a svcacct in 30m (maria)
samir: taking #1 now. Will create a short-lived rollback plan and PR to infra-iam.
ravi: adding exception ticket TKT-4982 for legacy-backup; will annotate with compensating controls.
lex: I'll push a patch in INF-1327 to exponential backoff + circuit-breaker, aim to ship in next deploy window.
maria: creating a detection rule: query will be `resource.type="kms_key" AND protoPayload.methodName:"AsymmetricSign" AND principalEmail:svcacct-*` with a threshold. Drafting in detection repo.
elaine: please also add an item to the next access review to re-evaluate all svcaccts with roles/kms.admin (we should not have any production svcacct with admin).
samir: note — changing roles might break anything that expects admin-level calls (rare). I'll include a canary test and alert on errors.
ravi: good call. I'll coordinate a canary run after the role change, and we can fallback immediately if errors spike.
security-bot: Incident workflow note: created incident CH-2024-76 and linked tickets [INF-1327, TKT-4982]. Reminder: 72h post-mortem required if service impact >1hr.
elaine: thanks everyone. If you find any evidence of exfil or unauthorized key export, escalate to sec-ops immediately. Reply in-thread with status updates. :eyes:
lex: quick status — pushed retry fix to staging, ran local canary, no additional KMS admin calls. will schedule prod patch tomorrow. :thumbsup:
samir: role change PR open: https://git.redwood.internal/infra/iam/pull/214 — includes smoke test and rollback.
maria: detection rule PR: https://git.redwood.internal/security/detections/pull/89 — includes alert to #sec-ops.
ravi: TKT-4982 updated with compensating control notes and ETA for remediation 2024-03-22.
elaine: marking this as actionable and moving to CH-2024-76. thanks all.
